name: per-datum-egress-verbatim-reuse
description: Opt-in per-datum egress end to end: reading an entry mints a pt-tag and the emitter wraps the result in a nonce'd pt-untrusted region; the model reuses that region VERBATIM in its reply; the egress content-binding check verifies the region's content against what the platform stored for its id and the PER-DATUM path allows it (the region's readers include the channel user). Proves emitter + content-binding + per-datum egress run in a live session, and that the markers are stripped before the human sees the reply.
